theirReference: Gracias Cristian y familia por tan buena acojida y tan buenos momentos compartidos. Bienvenidos a Catalunya!
myReference: Marc se hospedó conmigo durante su paso por la ciudad. Fue un huésped amable, con buena disposición y siempre mostraba entusiasmo por salir, explorar y conocer lugares nuevos.

theirReference: What a wonderful experience meeting Cristian and his wonderfull family. I felt lime one of the family since 1st day. Cristian brought me to meet other CS and had dinner out together. His mum was wolderful and his little brother Ryan is also a cool yourng man. I loved their attitude and their genuine curiosity and openess to different cultures. I stayed also two nights more than expected and they were so kind to let me stay. I will recommend to host Cristian without doubt.
myReference: Marco es una persona increíble muy amigable e inteligente, siempre dispuesto a ayudar. Estuvimos caminando por la candelaria. También fue con mi hermano a Monserrate y al museo de oro, es muy amable y es bastante interesante hablar con él

theirReference: I stayed with Christian and his family when I arrived in Bogota. My experience was very good, Christian is a really nice person and he really enjoys hosting people. I had my private room and bathroom which was really nice. The house is a non touristic neighborhood which I really enjoyed but really close to La Candelária and the view from the rooftop is amazing. I was sick my first day in Bogota and both Christian and his mom were really nice about it and made me feel comfortable. Also, Christian showed me around, helped me with my sim card and offered some homemade food! Thank you so much for the hospitality Christian, hope to see you soon!
myReference: Xanthi was a wonderful guest, very kind and genuinely interested in learning about the local culture. She was very clean, respectful, and overall it was a really pleasant experience hosting her. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ We shared a dinner at home with a traditional Colombian dish called arroz atollado, which made the experience even more special. 🫶 She always had a great attitude, communication was easy, and she followed all the house rules without any issues. ✨ We went for a walk around La Candelaria, where we had very nice conversations, and she also had the chance to try local food like empanadas and arepa de huevo. 🤗 Hosting her was definitely a great experience, and I would happily recommend her to any future host. 💯 Ελπίζω να τα ξαναπούμε. Καλή τύχη!

theirReference: I had a short but really nice stay with Cristian. Even though he was quite busy, we still managed to have breakfast together and explore the area a bit. He lives close to La Candelaria, which is a great part of Bogotá with lots of museums and impressive street art. Cristian also gave me some great recommendations for places to visit and local foods to try — which I really appreciated. Thanks again for your help and hospitality!
myReference: Aleksandar stayed with me and it was an excellent experience. We went together to Chorro de Quevedo, he tried chicha —a traditional drink from here— and he even invited me to breakfast. He has a true traveler’s spirit and understands the Couchsurfing community very well. He’s a very intelligent person, and we had many interesting conversations. He’s also open to learning about other cultures, clean, organized, and has great communication. I also really appreciate the fridge magnet from Montenegro 🇲🇪. He’s always welcome, my friend. I highly recommend him.
